about.statement.title: Artist's Statement
about.statement.body:
Being alive is a chilling experience;
ephemeral.
Being alive is a political act.

I am alive, and my art speaks of living close to mortality.
about.semblanza.title: Biography & Career
about.semblanza.body:
Lía Paz (Puebla, Mexico, 2006) is a fine artist. She trained for five years at Arte Taller Creativo (Atc) under Dr. Ramón, complementing her practice with courses in Composition, Artistic Anatomy, and Mixed Media, alongside Art History studies.

Her work explores mental health and contemporary human experience through portraiture and atmospheric rendering with a sensitive gaze; raising questions about the fragility of life, the quest for serenity, empathy, and the collective perspective on vulnerability.

She has exhibited in group shows, cultural festivals in Puebla (2025), and the Teletón Foundation virtual auction (Bernardini Art Gallery, 2021). She created the cover artwork for the singles “7 vidas” by Extrovertida and “Dhalia” by Redrum. She has received honors and recognitions for her excellence in drawing and artistic discipline.

services.header.title: Artistic Services
services.header.desc: Handcrafted works of art from my studio in Puebla, Mexico, celebrating human connections and unrepeatable moments.
services.s1.title: Custom Portraits
services.s1.desc: Portraits in acrylic and oil on canvas or linen dedicated to capturing the essence, gaze, and personality of the subject. Created in my Puebla studio and delivered worldwide. Ideal as a personal celebration, anniversary gift, or timeless family heirloom.
services.s1.d0: Individual, couple, family, or memorial portraits
services.s1.d1: Created from high-resolution photographs or a guided photo session
services.s1.d2: Preliminary tonal sketch and color palette consultation with the client
services.s1.d3: Successive layers in traditional oil with glazes for maximum luminosity
services.s1.d4: Multiple formats available: from 12x16 in (30x40 cm) to large statement sizes up to 40x48 in (100x120 cm)
services.s1.d5: Certificate of Authenticity signed by the artist
services.s2.title: Live Wedding Painting
services.s2.desc: An immersive artistic experience combining captivating live entertainment for your wedding guests and an original artwork you will treasure for a lifetime. I paint in real time the most meaningful moment of your union: the ceremony, the vows, or your first dance.
services.s2.d0: Arrival 2 to 3 hours prior to start painting the venue's architecture, atmosphere, and light
services.s2.d1: Live painting during cocktail hour and reception (5 to 7 hours on site)
services.s2.d2: Warm, respectful interaction with guests as the artwork evolves
services.s2.d3: Final studio refinement, fine facial detailing, and archival UV protective varnish
services.s2.d4: Professional Belgian linen canvas mounted on custom cedar stretcher bars
services.s2.d5: Hand delivery or fully insured, museum-grade white-glove shipping

services.faq.label: Common Questions
services.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
services.faq.q1: How far in advance should I book my wedding?
services.faq.a1: Booking 6 to 12 months in advance is highly recommended, especially for peak wedding season weekends (spring and autumn).
services.faq.q2: Do you travel outside of Puebla or internationally?
services.faq.a2: Yes. While based in Puebla, Mexico, I frequently travel to document destination weddings across Mexico and internationally. Travel and accommodation fees are quoted with complete transparency.
services.faq.q3: Is the painting delivered finished the very same night?
services.faq.a3: By the end of the celebration, the painting is 85% to 95% complete so newlyweds and guests can admire it. It then returns to the studio for fine facial refinement, proper drying, and archival varnish.
services.faq.q4: How can I commission a portrait if I live in another city or country?
services.faq.a4: The entire process is seamless online: you share your favorite reference photos, we agree on composition and size, and I provide progress photos before carefully packing and shipping the finished artwork.
